# VoxHearth 0.3.0

VoxHearth 0.3.0 adds an optional, memory-only live transcript subtitle strip.
It keeps the newest approximate words visible without taking focus, writing a
notification, or changing the separate final transcription used for insertion.

Download `VoxHearth-v0.3.0.dmg`, verify `SHA256SUMS`, open the disk image, and
drag VoxHearth to Applications. This official artifact is Developer ID signed,
notarized, and stapled by Apple.
